$comment: A spoke's secrets: one sops dotenv file per concern, terraform/secrets/<name>.enc (LIB-0012). `required_when` lists conditions, any one of which requires the file: `always`, `backend.<state_backend>`, or `provider.<name>` for a provider in spoke.hcl's providers map. A required file holds exactly `keys`, plus `keys_when.<condition>` while that condition holds (`state_backup` when spoke.hcl sets state_backup = true), every one non-empty. A file whose conditions don't hold is ignored, never decrypted. A file with no `required_when` is optional: every key matching `pattern` becomes local.<lowercased key> in every leaf, and must neither be `reserved`, a generated local's name, nor a key another file owns. A `<provider>_breakglass` file (LIB-0014; Cloudflare's and Backblaze's since LIB-0033, holding keys that can only mint the spoke's working key) is required under `breakglass.<provider>`, which holds only for the leaves spoke.hcl lists in that provider's `breakglass.leaves`. For those leaves, every key `replaces` names reads the breakglass key it maps to instead, and so does every key in `replaces_state` while state_backend is that provider. root.hcl applies this per leaf, for the files that leaf decrypts; .github/scripts/check-secrets.sh applies it spoke-wide from key names alone.
